abstract: We herein report an 18-month-old girl who presented with a retroperitoneal mature teratoma that later developed into an endodermal sinus tumor. Her symptoms included an expanding abdominal girth. The serum levels of alpha-fetoprotein were moderately elevated. The excised specimen was a benign mature cystic retroperitoneal teratoma measuring 18 x 11 x 8 cm in size. A hemorrhagic focus measuring 4 cm in diameter was present, which proved to be the focus of an endodermal sinus tumor histologically. The retroperitoneal mature teratoma observed in this case showed malignant germ-cell differentiation. The above case is thought to be extremely rare, but these findings also suggest the possibility of a mature teratoma presenting as a premalignant condition. The sequence of "mature teratoma--germ-cell malignancy" is thus considered to represent a new potential pattern of early phase of carcinogenesis in teratomas.
abstract_ja: 18か月の女児が腹囲拡大を主訴に来院した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は中等度に上昇していた。切除標本は18×11×8cmの良性様の後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。直径4cmの出血巣を認め、組織学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍の病巣であった。本例の後腹膜成熟奇形腫は悪性の胚細胞分化を示していた。本例は極めて稀と考えられるが、成熟奇形腫が前がん病変として存在し得ることを示唆する。「成熟奇形腫から胚細胞悪性腫瘍へ」という経過は、奇形腫の発がん過程における新たな初期パターンを示す可能性がある。
